summary: Tested Admin Inquiry Dashboard for DataVision platform. All backend APIs working (12/12 tests passed). Frontend UI working correctly - stats cards, inquiries table, search, status filter, view modal, and email actions all functional.
seed_data_creation: Created test inquiries via POST /api/inquiries during backend testing (TEST_FullInquiry, TEST_MinimalInquiry, TEST_GovInquiry, TEST_EnterpriseInquiry)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Inquiry Dashboard fully functional. Access via Admin Console > Marketing & Sales > Lead Inquiries. Backend stores inquiries in db.inquiries collection. Currently 17 inquiries in database with 13 marked as 'new' status. Stripe payments remain MOCKED as noted in previous iterations.

features_verified.GET /api/inquiries: WORKING - Returns all inquiries with stats (requires admin auth). Returns {inquiries: [...], stats: {total, new, contacted, converted}}
features_verified.POST /api/inquiries: WORKING - Creates new inquiry (public endpoint, no auth required). Accepts name, email, phone, organization, organizationType, country, employeeCount, message, solution, solutionName, type
features_verified.admin_authentication: WORKING - Login with admin@datavision.co.tz / admin123 returns JWT token. Non-admin users get 403 on admin endpoints
features_verified.inquiries_table: WORKING - Displays contact name, email, organization, country, solution, status badge, date, and action buttons
features_verified.stats_cards: WORKING - Shows Total Inquiries (17), New (13), Contacted (0), Converted (0)
features_verified.search_functionality: WORKING - Filters inquiries by name, email, organization in real-time
features_verified.status_filter: WORKING - Dropdown filters by status (all, new, contacted, qualified, converted, closed)
features_verified.view_button: WORKING - Eye icon opens modal with full inquiry details
features_verified.inquiry_detail_modal: WORKING - Shows contact info (email, phone, org type, country), solution interest section, message, submission time, employee count, Reply via Email button
features_verified.refresh_button: WORKING - Reloads inquiry data from API
features_verified.email_action_link: WORKING - mailto: links with pre-filled subject line for replying to inquiries

backend_tests_passed: test_admin_login_success - Admin login returns token with is_admin=true
test_create_inquiry_full_data - Creates inquiry with all fields
test_create_inquiry_minimal_data - Creates inquiry with minimal required fields
test_get_inquiries_with_auth - Returns inquiries and stats with valid admin token
test_inquiry_data_fields - Verifies inquiry response contains expected fields
test_stats_counts_match - Stats counts match actual inquiry status distribution
test_non_admin_cannot_get_inquiries - Regular users get 403 on admin endpoints
